dataset: INSPIRE-AVR Extended Clinical Archive (99 Verified Cases from 100 Archive Folders)
provenance_note: Extracted from data-assets/INSPIRE_AVR/INSPIRE_AVR.zip containing 100 case directories (IM000001..IM006106). Directory IM000189 is empty in the raw archive, yielding 99 complete clinical cases (expanding upon the classic 40-image Iowa Normative Set reference subset). Archive filename typos in 7 cases (including IM000001--artry.jpg and IM000001/IM000168--veins.jpg verified at 99.86% vessel pixel intersection with IM000001--vessels.jpg) were normalized to canonical {case_id}--arteries.jpg and {case_id}--veins.jpg.
